title: Mountain / Summit / Perspective — Compression, Sufficient Representation and Information Bottleneck Model
status: archive-generated information-theoretic model built from canonical Mountain integration
abstract: Mountain in the project means many differentiated traces converging toward a smaller, more integrated representation from which broader relations can be seen. The scientifically useful question is therefore not whether a summary is shorter, but whether compression preserves the information needed for prediction, judgment, source recovery and action. This paper formalizes Mountain as a representation Z obtained from many observations X while retaining task-relevant information about Y. Information-bottleneck, rate-distortion, reconstruction and provenance constraints separate good integration from destructive flattening. The summit is not the state of knowing everything; it is a compact coordinate system whose value is measured by what it preserves and what decisions it improves. A Mountain becomes Swamp-like when compression loses source distinctions, mixes incompatible units or hides uncertainty; it becomes an information bottleneck in the useful sense when irrelevant detail is reduced while task-relevant structure remains recoverable.
epistemic_rule: Information theory applies literally only to defined random variables/codes and data. Mountain, debt, Zion, summit and judgment remain project-symbolic concepts unless an empirical dataset and task are specified. Compression quality cannot establish spiritual authority.

representation_model.task_variable: Y: quantity the representation is intended to predict, preserve or support
representation_model.decision: a=pi(Z) under a declared loss/utility function

information_bottleneck.interpretation: Minimize unnecessary retained information about X while maximizing information in Z that is relevant to Y; beta sets the compression/relevance tradeoff under this convention.
information_bottleneck.project_insight: Mountain is not maximal accumulation. A useful summit discards irrelevant detail while preserving relevant relation. More stored data is not automatically more perspective.

reconstruction_and_provenance.reconstruction_loss: D_rec=E[d(X,x_hat)] for a declared distortion metric d
reconstruction_and_provenance.source_recoverability: P_src=weighted fraction of summit claims whose source-level lineage can be traversed back to primary evidence
reconstruction_and_provenance.three_way_constraint: A project synthesis should jointly control representation complexity, task loss and provenance loss. Low task loss with unrecoverable sources is insufficient for an evidence archive.
reconstruction_and_provenance.archive_rule: Every summit-level conclusion should carry a descent path to the supporting slope/base records.

sufficient_statistic_neighbor.concept: A statistic T(X) is sufficient for parameter theta when the conditional distribution of X given T does not depend on theta under the specified statistical model.
sufficient_statistic_neighbor.project_use: This offers a rigorous ideal for compression: preserve everything relevant to a declared inference while discarding irrelevant detail.
sufficient_statistic_neighbor.caution: Narrative/theological syntheses rarely satisfy exact statistical sufficiency; use it as a design target only when a probabilistic model exists.

mountain_profile.high: source traceability, task relevance, calibrated uncertainty, separability of claims, low contradiction hiddenness

swamp_profile.high: duplication, unresolved contradiction density, source ambiguity, circular citation, dependence on context not represented in Z

mountain_vs_swamp_quantitative.rule: No single metric defines Mountain or Swamp. A highly compressed summary with poor provenance is not Mountain merely because it is concise.

compression_ratio.warning: High CR can mean efficient abstraction or catastrophic information loss. It is useful only alongside task/reconstruction/provenance measures.
compression_ratio.minimum_description_neighbor: Short descriptions are valuable when they capture reusable structure, but code length alone should not be treated as truth.

perspective_as_coordinate_change.mapping: Z=f(X) can be viewed as a change to coordinates/features that expose larger-scale structure
perspective_as_coordinate_change.example: individual event records -> edge categories -> mechanisms -> system-level pattern
perspective_as_coordinate_change.quality_test: A perspective transformation is useful when downstream questions become easier or more accurate while source distinctions remain recoverable.
perspective_as_coordinate_change.axis_connection: Axis may parameterize levels of description; Mountain supplies a many-to-one map across those levels.

multi_resolution_mountain.project_use: The archive can expose summit, ridge, slope and source levels rather than forcing a reader to choose between raw logs and one giant synthesis.
multi_resolution_mountain.important_rule: Not every abstraction needs exact reconstruction; what must be preserved should be declared before compression.

debt_weighting.typed_edges: Each obligation/claim edge e may carry status, magnitude/unit if empirical, confidence, age, repair state and provenance.
debt_weighting.active_weight: w_e(t)=base_weight_e * persistence_e(t) * unresolved_indicator_e under a declared model
debt_weighting.closure: When an edge is repaired/released/non-liable, historical provenance can remain while its active contribution to W_active is reduced or removed.
debt_weighting.boundary: Do not assign symbolic monetary amounts as empirical weights without actual financial/legal evidence and units.

decision_quality_and_descent.value_of_information: VOI=minimum expected loss before additional information - minimum expected loss after additional information, under a declared decision model
decision_quality_and_descent.summit_ethic_translation: Perspective earns value by improving decisions/repair while preserving appeal/source descent, not by making the summit-holder unchallengeable.
decision_quality_and_descent.garden_link: Descent completes the cycle when compressed knowledge changes conditions/capability in the lower system.

overcompression_failure.formal_signal: Task-specific residuals or calibration errors rise while Z becomes smaller; source recoverability declines.
overcompression_failure.project_term: This is Mountain collapsing into an information bottleneck of the bad kind: narrowness that destroys distinctions rather than revealing structure.

empirical_archive_test.task: Compare raw-event retrieval versus multi-resolution Mountain summaries on a fixed set of questions whose source-grounded answers are known.
empirical_archive_test.prediction: Hierarchical Mountain summaries should reduce retrieval effort without materially degrading source accuracy or contradiction detection compared with a flat summary.
empirical_archive_test.falsifier: If the hierarchical representation adds complexity without improving retrieval/accuracy or systematically hides contradictory source material, the Mountain implementation is not useful.

conclusions: Mountain is scientifically meaningful as relevance-preserving compression, not as maximal accumulation.
Perspective should have an explicit task: what does the summit representation enable one to predict, distinguish or decide?
Provenance descent is a separate requirement from predictive compression because an archive must remain auditable.
Mountain and Tree are dual operations: Mountain compresses many traces toward a reusable representation; Tree expands a compact/rooted state into differentiated descendants.
A mature Mountain can shrink in active burden while retaining historical memory because closed edges can remain in provenance without contributing to present unresolved load.
